scenes.title: THE SILENCE (PROLOGUE)
scenes.objective: Cadet Arjun wants to reach Dev before the cascade completes.

shots.action: Black frame resolving into a single red alarm gyro reflected in a young man's wet eye; the pupil contracts as the light sweeps past
shots.light: single rotating red gyro, everything else black
shots.sound: 38Hz sub-bass; distant klaxon; Amara V.O. 'Anchor before you build.'

shots.angle: extreme high, looking straight down the shaft
shots.action: Reveal of the 60m brass-ringed containment shaft plunging 200m; sixty Corps personnel evacuating four levels of catwalk; steam venting; crystal filament veining the concrete
shots.light: amber sodium work lamps, spinning red gyros, a growing white glow from the base
shots.vfx: full CG shaft extension below level 4; crystal filament growth; volumetric steam
shots.sound: klaxons, hydraulics, running boots, hum rising

shots.action: Cadet Arjun shoulders upstream through the evacuating crowd, hauling himself up a ladder against the flow
shots.light: amber practicals raking, red gyro strobing across his face
shots.sound: crowd, metal, his breathing loud in the mix

shots.action: Dev pinned beneath a collapsed brass containment arm on the level-3 catwalk, entirely calm, oxblood cloak spread in the steam
shots.light: amber key from below, white bloom edge-lighting his right side
shots.vfx: CG containment arm; sparks; the white bloom glow
shots.sound: the hum takes over the mix

shots.action: Dev: 'Cadet. Go up.' Perfect calm. A steam vent blows past behind him
shots.light: amber key, hard shadow, white rim growing
shots.sound: dialogue dry and close against the enormous room tone

shots.action: Arjun kneeling at the rail above Dev; the argument; the shaft lurches and dust falls between them
shots.light: amber, red gyro passing every 2s
shots.sound: structural groan under dialogue

shots.angle: low, looking down the shaft past the catwalk
shots.action: The white bloom being born at the base of the shaft — not fire; a soundless, patient, gentle white expansion rising ring by ring
shots.light: the bloom is the only source; everything silhouettes
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — the Bloom: a non-turbulent, slow, glassy white expansion, no flame, no smoke, consuming catwalks silently
shots.sound: ALL SOUND DUCKS to a single sustained 38Hz tone

shots.action: Arjun looks at the bloom, at Dev, at the lever. Decision lands on his face
shots.light: white bloom key from below, amber fill dying
shots.sound: heartbeat only

shots.action: The brass containment ring lever, red-painted grip, chest height, 40m of catwalk away, going out of focus then sharp
shots.light: amber practical, white spill
shots.sound: a single metallic chime

shots.action: Arjun runs the catwalk. The lever fills frame. His hand reaches — CUT TO BLACK 4 frames before contact
shots.light: blown white, amber gone
shots.sound: everything → ABSOLUTE SILENCE for 3s over black

scenes.title: THE DROWNED CATHEDRAL
scenes.objective: Arjun wants 30kg of copper before his air runs out; the anchor-stone wakes.

shots.angle: high wide, looking down through the broken skylight
shots.action: A single vertical green god-ray falls 18m into a submerged barrel-vaulted transit hall; cast-iron columns; silt-drifted benches
shots.light: one vertical god-ray, deep viridian falloff
shots.vfx: full CG environment extension; particulate; caustics
shots.sound: underwater pressure bed, distant metal groan

shots.action: Arjun in patched neoprene and rebreather works a copper bus-bar loose with a pry bar; amber lamp on his mask cutting the green
shots.light: amber head-lamp key, green ambient fill
shots.sound: regulator breathing dominant

shots.action: A dive slate; grease pencil writes EXIT — NORTH ARCH — THIRD COLUMN. Camera holds; we see the same sentence already written three times above it
shots.light: amber lamp only
shots.sound: pencil scrape, breathing

shots.action: Arjun through the mask — the moment he registers his own repetition. No reaction. He is used to it
shots.light: amber lamp bounce on glass, green rim
shots.sound: one skipped breath

shots.action: He swims over the Corps hexagon inlaid in the terrazzo floor — the open-sided hexagon, half-buried in silt — and does not look at it
shots.light: god-ray behind him, silhouette
shots.sound: low hum begins under the bed

shots.action: The brass anchor-stone at his hip pulses amber. Once. Twice. A heartbeat
shots.light: self-lit amber pulse, green ambient
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — anchor-stone pulse; internal amber glow through brass cage lattice
shots.sound: a soft bell, felt more than heard, 1Hz

shots.action: Arjun stops dead in the water. Stares at his own hip. Says 'No.' through the regulator
shots.light: amber pulse now keying his face from below
shots.sound: breathing stops; the bell continues

shots.angle: extreme low, looking up the skylight shaft
shots.action: Tiny figure of Arjun 18m below a distant grey coin of surface light, fist closed around the pulsing stone
shots.light: surface coin blown out, everything else viridian
shots.sound: the bell, the hum, and rain heard faintly from above the water

scenes.title: THE STILTWAY / THE KITE RUNNER
scenes.slug: EXT. STILTWAY MARKET & TOWER SIX ROOF
scenes.objective: Arjun wants to sell copper and stay invisible; Kira wants his regulator.

shots.action: Nine stilt-towers of stacked shipping containers and bamboo scaffold rising out of grey water, forty rope walkways, LED string lights, tarpaulin in saffron and teal, rain sheeting
shots.light: flat grey monsoon key, warm 2700K practical pockets
shots.vfx: CG city extension, rain sim, atmospheric haze
shots.sound: rain on ten thousand tin roofs; the city's chord

shots.action: Arjun crosses the market deck with copper on his shoulder, hood up, moving through vendors, marigolds, plastic-sheet rain capes
shots.light: grey key, string-light practicals, oil-drum fire warmth
shots.sound: market Tamil/Bengali/Yoruba chatter, hawkers, radios

shots.angle: low, tilted up along the walkway ropes
shots.action: Hundreds of WHITE PAPER MEMORIAL KITES hanging from the Long Walk ropes in the rain, sodden, turning
shots.light: backlit by grey sky, LED strings foreground
shots.vfx: cloth sim on hundreds of kites
shots.sound: paper in wind; the market drops 30% under it

shots.angle: low, from below the roof edge
shots.action: Kira runs the roof edge of Tower Six barefoot, kite spool in hand, saffron-and-black kite cutting an arc; two kids screaming behind her
shots.light: grey sky backlight, rim on wet skin
shots.vfx: kite line physics; CG kite crowd in bg
shots.sound: laughter, line singing, wind

shots.action: Kira's face, wet, grinning, calling 'LINE—' as she cuts a rival kite; three copper clips catching the light
shots.light: soft grey wrap, wet-skin specular
shots.sound: the Stiltway roars off-screen

shots.action: Bhaskar weighs the copper at his yard, offers 260, adds a foil packet of food on top without comment
shots.light: work-lamp key, torch spark flare, warm
shots.sound: grinder, rain on corrugated steel

shots.action: A shoulder-brush in the crowd. Kira is six metres gone before Arjun's hand reaches his harness
shots.light: grey, practicals
shots.sound: one clean brass click in the mix

shots.action: The empty regulator socket on Arjun's canvas harness — a brass ring with nothing in it
shots.light: grey
shots.sound: rain

shots.angle: low, Arjun's POV up to the walkway
shots.action: Kira on the walkway above, weighing the stolen brass regulator, entirely unashamed; delivers her two lines and vanishes
shots.light: backlit grey, LED strings
shots.sound: her voice carrying over the market

shots.action: Arjun in the rain — and the corner of his mouth moves. First almost-smile in twelve years
shots.light: soft grey, one warm LED kick on the left cheek
shots.sound: market fades slightly; a single warm note enters the score

shots.action: Every strung screen in the market cuts to an AUTHORITY BULLETIN: CARRIER SWEEP — SECTOR NINE — COMPLIANCE IS PROTECTION. The market's noise halves
shots.light: screens now the brightest thing in frame, cyan cast
shots.sound: a hard institutional chime; the crowd goes quiet in a wave

scenes.title: THE SWEEP
scenes.objective: Riya wants a clean sweep with zero discharges; Arjun wants to not exist.

shots.action: Six grey Kestrel skiffs drop onto the market deck through the rain, twin fans blasting water horizontally, tarpaulins tearing loose
shots.light: skiff landing lights as hard cyan key; market practicals blown sideways
shots.vfx: CG skiffs, rotor wash sim, debris
shots.sound: twin-fan howl, water blast, canvas tearing

shots.angle: low hero angle, then dropped to eye
shots.action: Riya steps off skiff #6, gloves, bun, water running off the shoulder cape; the hero angle deliberately collapses to eye level as she starts speaking to civilians
shots.light: skiff light rim, market warm fill
shots.sound: her voice calm, unamplified

shots.move: slow lateral dolly along the line
shots.action: A line of civilians with wrists out, palms up, in the rain; Authority riot units clumsy in the wet, one slips
shots.light: flat dusk grey, oxblood chevrons the only colour
shots.sound: rain, a baby, radio chatter

shots.action: Officer Pande's visor, breath fogging inside it, hands too tight on the Nullpin launcher
shots.light: cyan launcher indicator underlighting the visor
shots.sound: his breathing amplified

shots.action: A fruit-seller moves suddenly; Pande fires; a Nullpin buries in the man's thigh; he screams and NO LIGHT comes out of him
shots.light: muzzle flash is a dull grey-blue, not a fireball
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Nullpin: 18cm spike, dull matte, no glow; a grey ripple across the man's skin that finds nothing
shots.sound: a DESCENDING METALLIC SWALLOW, not a gunshot

shots.action: Riya kneels in the wet, cuts the pin out herself, presses the wound with her bare hand, takes Pande's launcher off him
shots.light: low practicals, her face mostly in shadow
shots.sound: dialogue quiet under rain

shots.action: Riya stands and scans the crowd — the camera arcs past a man in a grey coat, face wrapped, hands in pockets, two metres away, not breathing
shots.light: dusk grey, string lights bokeh
shots.sound: everything drops out except rain for 2 seconds

shots.action: Riya's eyes catch on something. Almost registers. A radio call pulls her away
shots.light: one cyan skiff-light rake across her eyes
shots.sound: radio breaks the silence

shots.action: Arjun walks. Both fists come out of his pockets and they are visibly shaking
shots.light: backlit by string lights, face in shadow
shots.sound: rain; his heartbeat rising in the mix

scenes.title: WARD 12 / THE NOTEBOOK
scenes.objective: Arjun wants a recalibration and no conversation; Meera insists on the conversation.

shots.action: The L of welded containers: index-card wall, fishless aquarium glowing green, x-ray film curtain, Arjun in the repurposed dental chair, Meera working at his C7 with a soldering iron
shots.light: two hard 5600K surgical lamps, one warm desk lamp, green aquarium glow
shots.sound: rain on steel roof, solder hiss

shots.action: The copper stabiliser disc taped over his C7; silver-grey dendritic Threadwork radiating from beneath it across his back
shots.light: hard surgical key, deep falloff
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Threadwork: fine sub-dermal dendritic filament, matte silver-grey, dormant, no emission
shots.sound: solder, breath

shots.action: THE NOTEBOOK — waterlogged leather, black elastic band, opened flat. Handwritten rules legible: 'Your sister was called Ila. She drew fish.' / 'You are NOT ALLOWED to use the current.'
shots.light: warm desk lamp only, single soft source
shots.sound: page turn; rain

shots.action: Meera's brass prosthetic fingers turning to a section of NINE TORN-OUT PAGE STUBS
shots.light: same warm lamp; the prosthetic glows faint amber at the knuckle channels
shots.sound: paper, and the prosthetic's small servo

shots.action: 'How much of last month.' The noodle-stall speech. Arjun entirely calm while describing his own erasure
shots.light: warm desk lamp key on Arjun, surgical lamp edge on Meera
shots.sound: rain only under dialogue; no score

shots.action: Meera puts the iron down. Her prosthetic hums amber with fatigue. 'It's accelerating.'
shots.light: green aquarium fill on her left, warm key right
shots.sound: the hum of the arm

shots.action: The anchor-stone set on the bench. It pulses. Amber. Once. Twice
shots.light: self-lit
shots.sound: the 1Hz bell

shots.action: Meera goes absolutely still. Her brass hand closes. 'Then something in the Cradle is calling its hardware home.'
shots.light: amber pulse now keying her face, green fill dying
shots.sound: score enters for the first time: a single low cello note

scenes.title: THE LONG WALK (INCITING INCIDENT)
scenes.objective: Hollow want three carriers; Kira wants the kids off the walkway; Arjun wants to walk past.

shots.action: A bone-white harvest sled glides silently onto the market deck; twelve empty upright restraint frames; nine Hollow step off and WALK
shots.light: the sled is self-lit white — the cleanest object in the film so far
shots.vfx: CG sled, ground-effect hover, zero exhaust
shots.sound: NO ENGINE. Rain hitting a surface that makes no other sound. Market chatter dying

shots.action: The Hollow Lead reads three names off a small white card, pleasantly. The third is a boy of twelve
shots.light: white sled bounce, flat
shots.sound: his voice conversational, no reverb — wrong for the space

shots.action: The market erupts; hundreds of people funnel onto the 120m Long Walk between Towers Three and Six
shots.light: LED strings whipping, oil-drum fires, grey dusk
shots.sound: panic, planks, rope

shots.action: Kira mid-span, pushing the two kite kids ahead of her, then turning BACK for the twelve-year-old
shots.light: string lights, rain
shots.sound: her breathing, the crowd

shots.action: A Hollow's white glove closes on her wrist — and her hands IGNITE gold-white
shots.light: her own gold light becomes the key, blowing out the rain
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Tether ignition: gold-white #FFE9A8 core, #E8A33D edge, six uncontrolled filaments firing from her palms; gold dendritic hairlines surfacing on the backs of her hands
shots.sound: a singing tone like a wet finger on glass, six of them, out of tune

shots.action: The tethers scythe through the suspension ropes; 40m of the Long Walk's mid-span FAILS; sixty people fall eleven metres toward black water and steel
shots.light: gold flash, then grey collapse
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — full CG walkway collapse, rope snap sim, crowd sim, water impact
shots.sound: rope snap, timber, screaming, then a horrible silence as bodies fall

shots.action: At the deck edge, a man in a grey coat stops walking. Rain. Screaming off-screen. ONE SUBLIMINAL FRAME: the notebook line 'YOU ARE NOT ALLOWED'
shots.light: grey key, string bokeh
shots.sound: everything ducks to his breath

shots.action: Arjun drops to one knee and slams both palms onto the deck. ANCHOR. Cyan-white ignites from C7 down both arms
shots.light: his own cyan becomes the key light of the entire sequence
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Bastion ignition: cyan #B9F2FF core / #2FB8D6 edge running his real Threadwork paths
shots.sound: a deep glass CHIME, enormous

shots.angle: wide, low, from across the water
shots.action: THE HERO SHOT — a hexagonally tessellated plane of cyan hardlight crystallises out of nothing beneath the falling span, 40m wide, catching sixty bodies, then locking upward into a full bastion bridge
shots.light: the bastion lights the entire Stiltway from below; nine towers suddenly visible in cyan
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — hexagonal tessellation growing outward from his palms at 40m/s, semi-transparent, refracting rain, amber stress fractures where bodies land
shots.sound: the chime resolving into a sustained chord; rain drumming on light

shots.angle: low, from beneath the bastion looking up through it
shots.action: Seen THROUGH the translucent hexagonal plane: Arjun kneeling at its centre, both palms down, blood from his left nostril, brow split by a rivet
shots.light: cyan from the plane, warm oil-fire from below
shots.vfx: seeing-through-hardlight comp; refraction of the figure
shots.sound: rain on the shield, hugely amplified

shots.action: Sixty people standing on light. Four hundred more stopped running. Twenty phones come up
shots.light: cyan from below on every face
shots.sound: the crowd's absolute silence, then one child's voice

shots.action: Kira on the far side, tethers still burning in her hands, staring at him. Across her face: there is another one of me
shots.light: gold on her, cyan on him, the gap of rain between
shots.sound: score: the two-note Guardian theme, first full statement

shots.action: He lifts his hands. The bastion holds two seconds — then dissolves into drifting light-dust. The gap in the Long Walk is a gap forever
shots.light: cyan dying to grey; the city goes dark again
shots.vfx: dissolve to particulate; the light-dust drifts and is rained through
shots.sound: the chord decays; rain returns at full volume

scenes.title: THE SPIRE / OSE
scenes.objective: Riya wants to identify the signature before Ose does; Ose wants a public arrest.

shots.action: The Bastion Spire: 300m of board-formed brutalist concrete, oxblood stencilled numerals, external buttresses, rain, one lit floor
shots.light: storm-grey, cyan interior spill from a single floor
shots.sound: storm, and the building's low hum

shots.action: Forty monitors of Stiltway phone footage, all showing the hexagonal bridge blooming; Riya small in front of them
shots.light: cyan fluorescent + 40 screens as the key; rain-streak shadows on her face
shots.vfx: 40 screen comps of the Sc.6 footage at phone quality
shots.vfxNote: footage must match Sc.6 angles exactly
shots.sound: forty tinny copies of the same chime, slightly out of sync

shots.action: Riya watches it for the eleventh time. Her hand goes flat on the desk
shots.light: screen light only, cold
shots.sound: the loop; her breathing

shots.action: Minister Ose enters: ivory high-collar coat, jade signet, silver-black chignon. Asks 'Class.'
shots.light: warm ivory pool follows her — she carries her own light and it is the wrong temperature for the room
shots.sound: her heels; the room's hum

shots.action: The 'register is a document' exchange; Riya's silence
shots.light: cyan on Riya, ivory on Ose, a hard line between them
shots.sound: no score at all

shots.angle: wide, from behind them at the window
shots.action: Ose at the rain-streaked glass, the drowned city below; 'Bring him in. Alive, if you're quick.'
shots.light: backlit by the city, both in silhouette
shots.sound: rain; a single low piano note to end the scene

scenes.title: THE STONE OPENS
scenes.objective: Arjun wants the stone shut off; it opens instead.

shots.action: Arjun in the chair with a split brow; Kira by the door, arms crossed, a knife she thinks nobody noticed; Meera working
shots.light: surgical lamps, green aquarium, warm desk
shots.sound: rain, instruments

shots.action: The stone pulses faster. Amber. Amber. Amber. Then the brass cage UNFOLDS like a seed head
shots.light: self-lit, throwing amber across the whole room
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — brass cage unfolding animation, practical prop + CG petals
shots.sound: brass mechanism; the bell accelerating

shots.action: A shoulders-up volumetric of Dev forms above the stone — grey beard, broad shoulders, one crystalline white-blue eye — edges dissolving into grain
shots.light: the volumetric is the only light source now; everyone else lit amber-cyan from it
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — volumetric memory projection: not a hologram; a light-field with grain, scan-drift, and edges that dissolve into particles. No UI, no interface, no sci-fi lines
shots.sound: his voice carries clinic room-tone as if he is physically present

shots.action: Meera's steel tea tumbler hits the floor, out of focus in the foreground; her face does not move
shots.light: amber volumetric key
shots.sound: the tumbler rolling, loud

shots.action: Dev's recording: 'I've found the way to make it stop hurting. It isn't a metaphor, Arjun, it's engineering. Come home. Bring nothing.'
shots.light: self-lit volumetric, grain
shots.sound: warm, exhausted, kind

shots.action: Arjun stands so fast the chair goes over; the refusal speech; the cruelty to Meera; the apology
shots.light: the volumetric collapses mid-scene and the room drops back to surgical white
shots.sound: the fall of the chair is the loudest sound in the scene

shots.action: Behind the argument, out the window in the rain: something WHITE glides past. Silent. Nobody sees it
shots.light: white sled self-light through rain-streaked plastic window
shots.sound: absolutely nothing where an engine should be

scenes.title: WARD 12 BURNS (PLOT POINT I)
scenes.objective: Sera wants Kira intact; Arjun wants everyone out.

shots.action: The clinic door is not broken — it is UNBOLTED, politely, from outside. It swings
shots.light: rain-dark exterior beyond
shots.sound: three bolts, unhurried

shots.action: Sera Vance steps in out of the rain — bone-white lacquer, mirrored chrome eyes, platinum crown braid — and is ABSOLUTELY DRY
shots.light: her plates catch and return every light in the room
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — mirror-plate reflections must be true ray-traced returns of the actual set; chrome sclera comp on both eyes
shots.sound: no footstep sound at all

shots.action: 'It doesn't hurt, and afterwards you won't mind that it happened.' A genuine warm smile. Then the echo: 'Won't mind that it happened.'
shots.light: green aquarium fill; her face is the palest thing in the film
shots.sound: the echo is 400ms delayed and 8dB down

shots.action: Arjun throws a bastion wall across the room — Sera raises a gauntlet — the wall's own force REVERSES and puts Arjun through the pegboard wall
shots.light: cyan flash, then inverted silver flash
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — Reflection: the bastion's cyan is returned as an inverted silver-white vector along the identical path, one frame delay
shots.sound: chime, then the chime played backwards

shots.action: Meera swings the surgical lamp into Sera's head; Sera takes it, turns, and puts the resonance blade through Meera's right shoulder — unhurried, no anger
shots.light: the swinging lamp throws the entire room into rotating hard shadow
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — resonance blade: NO GLOW, only a heat-shimmer blur along the edge; blade passes through cloth and tissue without a fire element
shots.sound: the blade is a 4kHz whine that stops dead on contact

shots.action: Kira SCREAMS; six tethers fire wild, wrapping aquarium, lamp rig and ceiling gantry; she yanks; the gantry comes down; sparks into the coolant tank; the clinic catches
shots.light: gold flash → electrical arc white → fire orange
shots.vfx: tether sim, gantry destruction, electrical arc, fire ignition
shots.sound: glass, water, arc crack, ignition whump

shots.action: Arjun on his knees among ten thousand burning index cards, each one a person's memory, curling into ash around him
shots.light: fire orange from below, the only warm-hero lighting in Act I
shots.sound: paper fire; the score's first minor-key statement of the Memory theme

shots.action: 'The cards—' / 'They're gone.' / 'THEY'RE NOT CARDS—' They drag Meera out through the roof hatch into the rain
shots.light: fire behind, rain-dark ahead
shots.sound: Meera's line is the only shout in the film so far

shots.action: Under the burning gantry, Sera sits up. A hairline crack across her LEFT gauntlet. She looks at her own reflection in it — and turns it away from her face
shots.light: fire underlight, mirror returns of flame
shots.vfx: cracked-mirror reflection comp; her own face visible in it for 6 frames
shots.sound: fire; and for one second, nothing else

scenes.title: SLUICE GATE 31
scenes.objective: Get Meera north and get across the wall.

shots.action: The Tidewall: 40m of concrete and rusted steel teeth running 60km into rain; searchlights raking the swell; a sign — NORTH OF THIS LINE — NO RECOVERY
shots.light: pre-dawn blue, sweeping sodium searchlights
shots.vfx: CG wall extension, ocean sim, rain
shots.sound: surf on concrete; wind

shots.action: Bhaskar's overloaded boat runs the sluice channel; Meera unconscious across the thwarts; Kira on the tiller because she's the only one who can see
shots.light: searchlight raking through, sodium orange, blue ambient
shots.sound: outboard scream, rain on oilcloth

shots.action: Two Kestrels come down the wall line; skiff #6 leads, canopy-less, Riya soaked, one hand on the launcher rail
shots.light: skiff landing lights, blue dawn
shots.sound: twin fans against surf

shots.action: 'Hold fire, we're over civilians.' Water streaming off her face. Pande argues on the radio. 'HOLD FIRE.'
shots.light: instrument glow underlighting
shots.sound: radio compression on her own voice coming back

shots.action: The second skiff fires anyway; Arjun anchors on the bow and throws a bastion plate; Nullpins go into it and STICK, quivering like darts in a board
shots.light: cyan bastion key, sodium rake
shots.vfx: HERO VFX — bastion plate with embedded Nullpins vibrating; cyan hexagon tessellation partially formed
shots.sound: the swallow sound ×5, then a hard glass thud each

shots.action: Arjun's nose opens. 'Where's — the girl's name. What's the girl's name.' / Kira, screaming over the engine: 'KIRA!'
shots.light: cyan dying on his face, blue dawn
shots.sound: engine, rain, her voice cracking

shots.angle: low, from ahead in the channel
shots.action: The boat hits the half-open Sluice Gate 31 at speed; steel screams; the port gunwale is torn off with 15cm to spare
shots.light: searchlight through the gate gap like a blade
shots.vfx: CG gate, collision destruction, sparks in rain
shots.sound: steel on steel, enormous

shots.action: Riya's skiff pulls up hard; her LEFT FAN COWLING clips the concrete and CRACKS — the mark it carries for the rest of the film
shots.light: sodium, sparks
shots.sound: a single sharp composite crack

shots.action: Green-white thermal: a man kneeling on a bow with light coming out of his forearms. The scope resolves his FACE
shots.light: thermal palette only — the one non-naturalistic image in Act I
shots.vfx: thermal scope comp; the Threadwork reads as pure white against warm grey
shots.sound: scope tone; her breathing

shots.action: Riya's thumb comes off the trigger. '...you idiot.' Then, on the radio: 'Negative. North of the wall is no recovery. Log it.'
shots.light: blue dawn, instrument glow
shots.sound: rain; the fans idling down

shots.action: Arjun's grey coat, snagged on a steel tooth of the sluice gate, flapping in the rain. Held. He never wears it again
shots.light: blue dawn, first light on wet concrete
shots.sound: wind in wet canvas; score: solo cello
